method: Manual Chromium browser journeys through Codex CUA, not automated test-case equivalents

checks.name: Switch A to B with an unsaved Rules draft
checks.evidence: Entered Unsaved Alpha draft, selected Batch A Beta; URL became beta and Tournament name became Batch A Beta. Old draft was not copied or saved.

checks.name: Back restores A and forward restores B
checks.evidence: URL, Current event and Rules name agreed after each history action. Returning to Alpha showed its saved name.

checks.name: Reload retains selected B
checks.evidence: Reload returned beta URL and Batch A Beta in the event selector.

checks.name: Operator brand opens same public event
checks.evidence: Brand from beta admin opened /?event=beta with Batch A Beta heading.

checks.name: Public TV link retains B
checks.evidence: TV mode opened /tv?event=beta with Batch A Beta heading.

checks.name: TV return link retains B
checks.evidence: Auction board opened /?event=beta with Batch A Beta heading.

checks.name: Public Operator link retains B
checks.evidence: Operator opened /admin?event=beta and the selector displayed Batch A Beta.

checks.name: New event selects and names its new URL
checks.evidence: Created Batch A Browser Creation through the modal; URL and selector followed returned created ID.

checks.name: Unqualified entry resolves once and pins newest event
checks.evidence: Navigated to / without query; loaded Batch A Browser Creation and replaced URL with its ID. Reload preserved the same ID and heading.

checks.name: Delayed A response cannot overwrite B
checks.evidence: Read-only proxy held one Alpha admin response. Selected Beta and observed its URL/selector before release. Status showed pending=1 then pending=0, delivered=175 then 176. After release URL, selector and Beta Team heading still represented Beta.

limitations: Existing local mock identity; real hosted sign-in and distinct accounts remain unverified.
Sign-out return URL was inspected; shared localhost browser cookies were not signed out.
No new fullscreen, physical-device, responsive or display-containment acceptance is claimed.
A timed-out first tab creation and an incorrect Operator area locator were harness interruptions; fresh DOM inspection located the actual Operator link.
cleanup: Agent test tabs closed; read-only proxy and isolated server stopped. Original localhost:5173 review tab and process retained.
